statement: The first line holds q. Each of the next q lines is one of: insert w, count w, countpre w, erase w. The trie allows duplicates: insert w may run many times. count w reports how many copies of exactly w are stored; countpre w reports how many stored words (with multiplicity) start with w; erase w removes one copy of w (guaranteed present). Print the results of every count and countpre on one line, space-separated. Maintain two counters per node - words ending here, words passing through - adjusted by insert and erase.
constraints: Every erase targets a stored copy.

example.input:
8
insert apple
insert apple
insert apps
count apple
countpre app
erase apple
count apple
countpre app
example.why: Two apples and one apps share the app path; one erase lowers both counters by one.

hint: Erase is insert with minus one - same walk, counters decremented, no nodes deleted.
mistake: Deleting nodes on erase; apps still needs the app path the deletion just destroyed.
